entities.name: Q1IMI3
observations: Exact full-sequence match to the 470-aa query; reviewed UniProt record annotates it as 3-isopropylmalate dehydratase large subunit (LeuC), EC 4.2.1.33.
Annotated to bind one [4Fe-4S] cluster per subunit; forms a heterodimer with LeuD.
Participates in L-leucine biosynthesis. Catalyzes interconversion of 2-isopropylmalate and 3-isopropylmalate via 2-isopropylmaleate.

entities.name: RHEA:32287
observations: Reversible isomerization: (2R,3S)-3-isopropylmalate ⇌ (2S)-2-isopropylmalate; proceeds via 2-isopropylmaleate, according to the matched UniProt enzyme annotation. EC 4.2.1.33.

entities.name: L-leucine biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme is annotated at step 2 of 4 in L-leucine biosynthesis from 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate.
